change: Third spatial layer uses stride1 instead of stride2. Re-encode reviewed boxes on 30x40 grid with 8px scene cells; fixed 16px complete-background uncertainty guard. Peak neighborhood remains 3x3 grid cells. This tests a grid pipeline change, not architecture alone.
training_gate: Both seeds improve decoded known blue target coverage on extra public FIT scenes without reducing known red coverage there or known red/blue coverage on original FIT scenes. No threshold or epoch sweep.
evaluation: Final epoch only. If training gate passes, export and compare both seeds on all three repeated development panels with the same classifier, thresholds and crop budget. Measure extra compute separately; do not infer Pi speed from parameter count.
unknown_regions: Remain unsupervised. Only existing reviewed negatives and approved complete-scene background may supervise heat cells. Drop an entire explicit negative region if it conflicts with positive supervision on the finer grid; record every dropped region. Never erase a positive to fit a negative.
